survivingClaim: MEASURED for Z <= 2^18, float64 with ball-arithmetic confirmation at Z = 256, 724, 1024: the probe (6.1) at S={2,lambda}, X=Y=Z^(1/2), under the conj(alpha), conj(G) reading, satisfies I_w = P_w + R_w for all 14 sign weights. P_w is the explicit principal-row sum, linear in the weight. Its coefficient is 1.000 +- 0.003 for Liouville, 1.001 +- 0.003 for the non-multiplicative control, and 1 within about 1.5 percent for THIN b=0.95 (three seeds and the greedy set). R_w is of size RP ~ Z^(-0.24) to within a factor 1.4, with an unexplained Liouville excess. The range is pre-asymptotic: only frequency a=1 contributes (support statement proved), so the signal exponent is beta-3/4; the exponent beta-2/3 sets in between 2^36 and 2^56 in a density model run for Liouville only. The pre-registered thresholds are undecided: abs(I_eps) <= 0.007 of the Cauchy-Schwarz value, and the THIN row-norm exponent equals that of weight 1 (1.02), so condition (N) is not seen. The measured surrogate of the high half does not distinguish periodic from non-periodic or non-multiplicative weights. That the periodicity input sits in the low half is not established; it is conditional on an unproved remainder bound as Z -> infinity. No statement about zeros of zeta.
